events.title: MATLAB debuts
events.summary: MathWorks launched the first commercial MATLAB in December 1984 — an interactive tool for engineers to crunch matrices and plot results on a PC.
events.about: MATLAB is built around matrices and vectors — engineers run simulations, plot data, and prototype control systems without writing low-level loops. Used in aerospace, automotive, finance, and academia. Simulink extends it for model-based design.

narrative.whyChosen: PC-MATLAB turned Cleve Moler's matrix hobby into the dominant numerical computing environment for engineers.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved interactive matrix math could ship on personal computers and sustain a commercial tools company.
narrative.problemSolved: Fortran-era engineers needed fast matrix operations and plotting without recompiling for every experiment.
